system.summary: Simple substitution of single letters by the numbers 1-23 and 33, written dot-separated ("5.7."), with clear German words between the runs and word division kept. a 5, b 10, c 12, d 11, e 4, f 13, g 14, h 17, i 2, k 15, l 16, m 6, n 7, o 1, p 22, r 8, s 9, t 23, u/v 3, w 33 (also written 3.3), x 18, y 19, z 20. A diaeresis over 3 or 1 gives ü or ö; a bar over a number doubles the letter.
system.notes: distinct_symbols is the 24 numbers of the two letters: the Elector's 22 letter values, 18 = x (from 'Weixel', 813.c) and 51 (twice, 813.a and 814.12), which is not a letter and from context stands for a person, perhaps the Elector; it may be a code word and is left as [51]. 33 and 3.3 are the same letter w.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment on the register copies. One web search (12 Nov 2026) and the catalogue vetting of 11 Nov 2026 found no edition or decipherment. Erdmannsdörffer, Graf Georg Friedrich von Waldeck (1869), not opened; it draws on the Arolsen archive and may quote the Waldeck side of this correspondence.

solution.what: Scans 787-789 and 813-814 captured from the archieven.nl viewer, as for targets/friedrichwilhelm1655.
The cipher passages and the clear words next to them transcribed in two passes from crops and reconciled; pass 2 was made with the key known. The clear text between the passages is not transcribed.

The key frozen from the Elector's letter c793 (targets/friedrichwilhelm1655) applied unchanged. These letters were not used to build it: every number in them is in the frozen key except 18 (x, from 'Weixel', added after the freeze) and 51 (twice).
Both letters decrypted mechanically and read as German with every departure marked; scripts/check_marks.py passes.

Independent review by an AI language-model agent: blind spot-check of cipher lines 813.a, 813.b, 787.a, 787.b, 814.05 and 814.07 (with nine lines of the Elector's letters) against the scans, all agreeing; mark check reproduced; reading review grade B for both letters. It found four line ends of 814 where a binding hole was dropped from the reading without a mark.

Fixes after the review: 814.05, 814.07, 814.08 and 814.10 marked {[...]/} (nothing is lost; the word runs on); w813 verbatim falls from 67 to 64 words, repairs rise from 2 to 5. scripts/reading.py now fails on any unmarked dropped hole. Sentence texts shipped in work/.

outcome.method_basis: The key recovered for the Elector's letters (targets/friedrichwilhelm1655, frozen on c793) applied unchanged; number 51 is outside it (a code word for a person).
outcome.fraction_read_source: All cipher passages of the two letters; the clear text between them is not transcribed.

texts.label: 7 Sept 1655, six passages
texts.summary: Conditions with Sweden could hardly be worse; letters sent to Jacob Weiher, Elbing and Danzig; will speak to the Bishop of Ermland; Danzig offers ships; vivres against cartage money or security; news to General Sparr.
texts.note: Passages only. 106 words (about 63 clear), 99 verbatim (93.4%), 1 repair, 6 fills, 4 holes; clean share 0.889.

reading_review.note: Only the cipher passages are edited and the clear text between them is left out, so several passages are fragments; 788.20-24 has 4 holes.

texts.label: Königsberg, 14 Sept 1655
texts.summary: Weiher offers help; Vistula boats ordered at Marienwerder; Magnus reports that Thorn resolves to defend itself and plans a meeting with Danzig, Elbing and the three voivodes on the Vistula, and is not unwilling to help [51].
texts.note: 72 words, 64 verbatim (88.9%), 5 marked repairs (four of them line ends in the binding where nothing is lost, marked {[...]/}), 3 fills, 2 holes ([51] twice); checker clean share 0.833 on the sentence text.

reading_review.note: The sentences hold. [51] (twice) is unresolved; reading it as the Elector is a guess.

gaps.detail: Only the cipher passages and the clear words next to them are edited; several passages of w787 are fragments for this reason.
Not a letter; from context a person, perhaps the Elector. Reading it as the Elector is a guess.
Four holes; letters lost in the binding.
2 or 12 not settled on the image.
